stops.note: the English word for a thin slice of breaded, fried meat
stops.meaning: a thin, breaded slice of meat

stops.note: borrowed and adapted into a breaded, deep-fried cutlet dish, then clipped to 'katsu'
re-imported into English as Japanese-style curry and cutlet dishes spread abroad

current_meaning: a Japanese-style breaded and deep-fried cutlet, typically pork or chicken
